title: RuneScape: Dragonwilds - Scorned Wilderness Fragments of Ghornfell Guide
author: Jacob Fox
description:
Welcome to Fragments of Ghornfell, the second section of the Scorned Wilderness in RuneScape: Dragonwilds!

Fragments of Ghornfell is where the Scorned Wilderness really starts to get intense. You'll be dealing with Black Dragons, Anima puzzles, dangerous parkour sections, poisonous sewers, plenty of mobs, and a Level 9 Abyssal Demon waiting at the end.

Early in the section, head up the stairs to the right to find a Black Dragon guarding a Sanguine Urn. Defeat it, complete the basic Anima puzzle behind it, and you'll permanently increase your maximum health.

From there, you'll need to solve an Anima puzzle involving Fire and Air Anima pylons. You'll need to use the Fire Anima pedestal, activate the orb dispenser, transport the orb to the Fire Anima pylon, and then charge the pylon. After that, you'll need to defeat three Air Anima Zombies to fully charge yourself with Air Anima and power the second pylon.

Beyond the pylons is a lengthy cavernous parkour section filled with mobs, difficult jumps, and a nasty poisonous sewer system. In this guide, I'll show you my route through both halves of the cavern so you can navigate the area without getting completely lost.

You'll also find the second Sanguine Urn during this section, bringing your total maximum health to 300.

The final challenge is a large castle room containing a Level 9 Abyssal Demon. Good luck, have fun, and expect to die unless you decide to use Tempest Shield and run straight past it!

Once you get beyond the Abyssal Demon, you'll reach the checkpoint for the next section of the Scorned Wilderness.

The Scorned Wilderness is made up of Level 8 areas, with Level 9 boss mobs sprinkled throughout. If you're preparing to explore the region, it's recommended that you first farm Rune and Luminite Ore to craft Rune gear. From there, you can farm Magic Trees and Vis to work toward higher-level armor and weapons.

That said, I went through the Scorned Wilderness wearing a full set of Obsidian armor and didn't have too many issues, so you don't necessarily need the highest-level gear to start exploring.

This is the second of four detailed guides covering each section of the Scorned Wilderness. Once all four sections are covered, I'll combine them into one complete Scorned Wilderness guide.

Don't forget to subscribe for more RuneScape: Dragonwilds guides, gameplay, updates, and everything happening in Ashenfall!
